_doc: A collection bid expresses a buyer's intent to purchase ANY inscription that is a valid member of a specific collection, at the stated price. The indexer must match this bid against any active listing for a member inscription. This is distinct from an inscription-specific bid which targets a single inscription_id.
_target_comment: This bid targets a collection, not a specific inscription. Omit inscription_id when bidding on a collection.
_collection_id_note: The inscription ID of the collection manifest. Indexers verify that any matched inscription is a valid member per the manifest's criteria field.
_bid_id_note: A unique identifier for this bid (the inscription ID of the bid inscription itself). Marketplaces use this to correlate bid with settle.
_price_note: 5,000 DOGE expressed in koinu (1 DOGE = 100,000,000 koinu). Buyer is willing to pay up to this amount for any collection member.
_buyer_note: The address making the bid. On settlement, the matched inscription must arrive at this address.
_expiry_note: Unix timestamp. Indexers MUST treat this bid as expired after this time even if no explicit cancel is found.
_nonce_note: Optional. Used by the buyer to prevent bid replay or to disambiguate multiple simultaneous collection bids.
_indexer_matching_rules: A collection bid matches any active listing for an inscription that is a valid member of collection_id
Membership is validated against the criteria field of the collection manifest (explicit list or range/prefix rules)
The settlement price must be >= the listing price AND <= the bid price
On settlement, inscription must transfer to buyer address
If multiple listings qualify, the marketplace UI selects one — the bid is settled when any one settles
After one matching settle, the collection bid is consumed (one-use by default)
Expiry check: if current_block_time > expiry, bid is invalid
